results.transcript: Guys, I really cannot believe this. How can this 40 years old pure veg restaurant in Dubai so affordable and underrated? This restaurant is known for the delicious North Indian and South Indian food. Best part is the affordability like this Chola Batura which is available for just 12 rims. Just look at the size of these Baturas. I mean it's damn good. Also these chats are perfect because they recently launched these unique starters which by the way are so yummy. This paneer butterfly, Why kya cheeje? and rocket baby corn are absolutely must try. Now in mains we had pancharatna which had 5 different gravies including dal makhni. We also had uttar dakshina which is a mix of North and South flavours but this paneer mirchi salan has our heart. This really was too good and we enjoyed all of these with variety of their breads. It is spicy but I love it. I also tried their Punjabi combo which was filling and fabulous but the best part was their dosas. They literally serve 60 types of dosas and these special dosas are available for just 13 dirhams. Unbelievable right? Well, we can eat this kind of food all day long. Now in dessert we tried their royal faluda and their special juice. I hate to say this but Prince finished whole faluda because it was really good. And I had the juice which I absolutely loved it. This is Milan Veg restaurant. By the way they have 3 branches in Dubai which one is in Muesna, Karama and Alkasis. Believe me you are going to love this restaurant. results.transcript: Akalaan mo yun na kapag breakfast date kami sa isang luxury restaurant dito sa Dubai at dito lang yan matatagpuan sa Dubai Mall na may view of iconic Dubai Fountain. Kaya panoorin mo ang video na ito hanggang dulo kasi may ibibigay akong code para may discount kayo at may experience nyo ito. Hello everyone! Ako nga pala si Jiro ang nag-iisang hunter dito sa Dubai. Dahil sobrang init na ng Dubai, pumunta kami ng Dubai Mall para magpalamig. Nang biglang nag-crave si misis ko, gusto niya daw ng affordable pero magandang view. Kaya agad kaming nag-research isang mura na magandang restaurant. Dito nga pala kami napadpad sa Dubai Mall. At habang naglalakad kami ay may nakita kaming luxury restaurant. Una nahiya pa kami ng pagpasok namin. Kasi nga sobrang elegant niya at mukhang mamahalin. Nung pagbigay sa amin ng menu, namang nga kami. Kasi ang mura lang pala, lalo na sa breakfast nila. Pinaghandaan pa kami ng table na pangkapol. May mga rosas, may candles, at basta. Sobrang VIP ang dating. Kasi nga daw, looks couple daw kami. Actually, pwede ka kumain sa halagang 35 dirhams lang. At sobrang sulit talaga. Nung nakita namin sa menu, akala namin maliit siya. Grabe, sobrang laki pala neto. Nag-order na din kami ng coffee. Kasi akala nga namin, maliit lang yung food namin. Hindi na nga natapos ni misis ang food niya. Kasi sobrang laki nga. Kaya tinake out na lang namin. At sobrang cute ng kanilang box. May mga magandang view din na pwede niyong pagpicturan. Pwede kayo sa outdoor nila. Kasi kitang kita magdalaga yung fountain nila. Dahil umabot sa support na ito, sasabihin ko na. Ang pangalan nga pala nito ay Doors Dubai. Dito lang ito matatagpuan sa Dubai Mall. Para hindi kayo mawala, ay isearch nyo lang sa digital directory. O kung gusto nyo, pa-book in advance ay may website din sila. O visit nyo lang yung Instagram nila. I-click nyo lang ang link para makita nyo ang offers nila. At ito nga pala ang code, INF0468. Make sure na na-screenshot mo to para di mo makalimutan. Kung katulad mo kami na mahilig mag-advise... venture ng mga mamahaling restaurant or hotels, ifollow nyo ako. Kasi gagawan natin ang paraan yan para makamura tayo. Sana makatulong ito. Hanggang sumuli, paalam!

📍 Metro View Restaurant – Opp. Sharaf DG Metro Station

🥑 Deal: Avocado Juice + Fries

💰 Original Price:—
🎉 Offer Price: AED 10
💸 You Save: AED 0

⭐ My Rating: 0/10

📝 Review:
This one was honestly a complete disappointment. We went to Metro View specifically to try their AED 10 Avocado Juice + Fries deal, but when we reached the restaurant, the staff told us they weren't aware of the offer or the Dubai Food Festival / Summer Surprises campaign.

And that's where the problem is. Having an offer advertised but not being able to serve it is disappointing but the outlet not even knowing about the offer makes the entire trip feel like a waste of time.

They do have several other affordable items, including Pav Bhaji for AED 5, Shawarma for AED 10 and Falafel for AED 3. I've tried their falafel before and actually enjoyed it. Unfortunately, many of the items we wanted to try were sold out when we visited.

💭 Value Verdict:
No offer = no savings.😐
I can't really rate the food deal because we couldn't try it in the first place. If an offer is being promoted, the outlet should be aware of it and be able to honour it. For this experience, it's a 0/10 from me.

Have you actually managed to get this deal at Metro View? Let me know! 👇
